2.6
FAISS Vector Database
Facebook AI Similarity Search (FAISS) is an open-source library developed by Meta for
efficient similarity search over high-dimensional vectors.
FAISS provides:
• Fast nearest-neighbor search
• Scalable indexing
• Low memory usage
• High search performance
• Support for cosine similarity
The proposed system maintains a separate vector index for each workspace to improve
scalability and organization.
2.7
FastAPI Framework
FastAPI is a modern Python web framework designed for high-performance REST API
development.
Its key advantages include:
• High execution speed
• Automatic API documentation
• Pydantic-based validation
• Asynchronous request handling
• Easy integration with AI libraries
These features make FastAPI suitable for implementing intelligent backend systems.
